rationale: Price action is essentially frozen — five consecutive 1-minute candles all printing at $50.43–$50.44 with negligible range, and the ATR on 5-minute bars is only $0.022, giving almost no room between a meaningful stop and a viable target. The negative news overhang (shareholder investigation into fairness of the EQT sale) creates asymmetric headline risk, and with the stock sitting at 83% of its already-tiny intraday range there is insufficient reward-to-risk in either direction to justify a new position alongside the existing open trade.
